purpose.const: Quiet foundational canvas: page backgrounds, large surfaces, and whitespace-bearing neutral areas.
Supporting contrast: alternate sections, cards, panels, brand-supporting surfaces, and substantial navigation/footer regions.
Scarce emphasis: primary CTAs, important links, selected states, badges, and intentional focal details.

default: Treat 60/30/10 as an approximate composition target, not pixel-exact arithmetic.
Keep accent visually scarce so primary actions remain prominent.
Apply the balance at page, viewport, and major-section scale rather than forcing every component to use all three roles.
Use semantic design tokens instead of hard-coded colors.
Do not introduce extra decorative colors when the three role hierarchy is sufficient.
Approved visual references may intentionally override the ratio when the exception is documented.
Accessibility and readable contrast override decorative ratio targets.
Functional semantic colors such as destructive, warning, success, and focus are not forced into the decorative 10% share.
Photography, illustration, gradients, and brand-specific art direction should not be measured as literal pixel percentages.
